cards.back: Always 0 (when the number is not zero). 0 ÷ 5 = 0.
cards.say: Zero divided by any other number is always zero. Zero divided by five equals zero.

cards.front: Division is the inverse of what?
cards.say: Division is the inverse of multiplication. If six times seven equals forty two, then forty two divided by seven equals six, and forty two divided by six equals seven.
